**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

The only MFN provision in the Agreement benefits us: at p1099, MSL agrees that MSL engineering "will be priced to IBM on a 'most favored customer' basis." That is a Vendor-granted MFN, which the playbook welcomes.

I checked for any reciprocal burden on IBM — searches for "less favorable"/"favourable", "best price", and third-party matching language returned nothing relevant, and the pricing provisions (§ 7.0 Price, § 8.2 Parts Cost Reductions) impose no obligation on IBM to extend MSL terms no less favourable than those given to third parties. The tooling provision at p1104 gives IBM a right of first refusal to match a third-party offer, which is an option in our favour, not an MFN obligation.

This sits at the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no edit is proposed.
